quotes: For most events, Claude Code writes stdout to the debug log and doesn't show it in the transcript. The exceptions are `UserPromptSubmit`, `UserPromptExpansion`, `SessionStart`, and `PostModelSwitch`, where Claude Code adds plain-text stdout as context that Claude can see and act on.
**Starts with `{` but doesn't end with `}`**: Claude Code treats it as plain text.
When several hooks return `additionalContext` for the same event, Claude receives all of the values.
